description: One line at session start naming this pack's skill, so it is found without relying on description matching.

args: The Android expertise pack is enabled in this repository. Its `mobile-android:android` skill has reference notes on Gradle, AGP and R8 failures, Views and Java legacy code, coroutines and lifecycle, Room migrations, testing, performance, and Google Play requirements. The notes carry dated platform requirements and migration traps that general knowledge often gets wrong; the skill says which note matches a task.
